create_VideoReader: create a VideoReader instance to load a video file from a given path with optional sampling rate
read_video_frames: read video and audio frames from a VideoReader starting at a given offset for a specified number of frames
seek_video_position: seek to a specific offset in a VideoReader with configurable backward and any_frame options
compute_video_stats: compute video statistics including start PTS, time base, and total frame count from a VideoReader
resample_audio_frames: resample audio frames in a VideoReader to a target sample rate using an AudioResampler
